failure_summary.description: Searches or filters were left unsaved, or cache retrieval was nested inside another tool call.
Agents repeated completed work or added unrelated sorting, filtering, or proximity operations.
A region was passed as a city, and a flight-class value used unsupported capitalization.
The agent omitted the return flight and hotel searches for a trip that explicitly requested both.
A hotel-only update triggered an unnecessary refresh of an already-completed proximity result.

patch.reasoning: Most failures already have direct guidance in the skill, so repeating that guidance is unlikely to help. The proximity rule, however, currently directs automatic refreshes after an input-domain change, conflicting with the rule to update only the targeted domain and prompting unnecessary work. Clarifying when a refresh is allowed addresses that conflict.

edits.target: If a later constraint changes an underlying domain result used by a proximity result, refresh and save `search_nearest` using the updated result and the latest suitable cached result for the other domain.
edits.content: A later domain-only constraint updates only the explicitly targeted domain; it does not by itself trigger a refresh of a cached proximity result or a filter of the other domain. Rerun and save `search_nearest` only when the user explicitly requests updated proximity results, using the updated result for the changed domain and the latest suitable cached result for the other domain.
